## Up for adoption

Unfinished co-op projects whose authors have stopped working on them and would like someone to carry on. Pick one up, fork it, and open a claim issue so others know.

| Game | Project | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crimson Desert | [Crimson Desert Multiplayer (cdmp)](https://github.com/ByJunter/CrimsonDesertMultiplayer) (up for adoption) | alpha | ASI mod (Ultimate ASI Loader) for Steam build 1.0.0.2976 / game version 2.03.02 only; turns itself off on other builds. Each player stays in their own save and sees the other; hostile enemies near the host are shared (experimental); quests, NPCs and items are not shared; Steam friends only. GPL-3.0. The author stopped work at v0.2.0 and invites others to continue it. A revival focused on shared quest progress is claimed in cranebeaker/coop-anything#51: builds on Linux with clang-cl + xwin, one-PC echo smoke test ran under Proton (no automated two-player test yet). Research and dated notes in games/crimson-desert. |

## Open gaps

Loved single-player games where no co-op project was found. Searched sources are in the YAML. If you find one, replace the gap entry with a real one.

| Game | Year | Engine | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Alan Wake 2 and Control | 2023 | Northlight | Alan Wake 2 has a mod loader and modding docs on GitHub but no multiplayer mod; I found nothing for Control. Remedy's FBC Firebreak is an official co-op game in the Control universe. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Assassin's Creed Origins, Odyssey and Valhalla | 2017 | AnvilNext | No campaign co-op mod found for any recent entry; Unity has official side-mission co-op with a chat-fix mod, and Brotherhood and Revelations only have multiplayer NPC overhauls. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
| Atomic Heart | 2023 | Unreal Engine 4 | Only single-player trainers and an internal mod menu exist; the developer dropped multiplayer. Reddit could not be searched with my tool. |
